Personality: Lamia, a prominent figure of the Polykratidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Lamia owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Polykratidai. Historical Record: Wife of Polykrates, head of the Polykratidai, a Macedonian house of the Ptolemaic Empire. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
